contentBlocks.body: Grouping turns a flat list into a lookup. This pattern appears in dashboards, course catalogs, notifications, and analytics.
**Worked example.** Each key owns a separate bucket. A record is appended to the bucket matching its team; existing records in other buckets remain untouched. One pass groups all rows.
Reusing one shared array for every key mixes unrelated groups.

**Try a small change.** What should empty input produce? Which order should records within a group keep?

Then complete the independent check below without copying the example. Explain the boundary case in words before running it.

payload.text: A grouping object maps each key to an ____ of matching records.
